title: Base and second-factor localization of an affine stalk input
statement: In an affine cartesian spectrum square with coefficient maps phi_gprime and phi_fprime agreeing with the tensor-algebra map, fix a complex M and prime p of Aprime. Let D be the Aprime stalk, Aq the A stalk at gprime(p), and Q the stalk complex of tilde(M). Give Aq its R-algebra structure by R to A to Aq. Let psi:Aq tensor_R Rprime to D restrict to the actual Aq-to-D stalk map and kappa composed with phi_fprime. For every base-derived tensor cohomology model m of Q tensor-derived_R Rprime with final coefficients D, and every D-linear chain isomorphism beta:D tensor_A M to D tensor_Aq Q sending 1 tensor x to 1 tensor the germ of x, there is a D-linear source isomorphism from D tensor_(Aq tensor_R Rprime) H_m^i to the source of the fixed stalk model's localizedComparison. For every chain isomorphism tau from D tensor_A M to the fixed tensorComplex which sends 1 tensor x to 1 tensor its germ, it intertwines m.localizedComparison followed by homology of beta inverse followed by tau with the fixed localizedComparison. The A factor has already been localized; only R and Rprime are localized in this assertion.

source.place: Affine displayed localization identity, base and second coefficient localization after M_q is fixed; Tag 06Y6, Lemma 15.61.1, for K-flat computation and independence of choices.

proof.text: Naturality of spectrum stalk maps identifies the coefficient maps from R and Rprime to their stalk rings and onward to Aq and D. The two psi restriction equations identify its maps with the corresponding restrictions of tensorMap. The base stalk is a prime localization of R, and the second stalk a prime localization of Rprime; their denominators already act invertibly on Aq and D. Apply base and second-factor localization to the unchanged complex Q, retaining its Aq-action.

First compare m to a base-derived model over the same R, Aq, Rprime, Q and D using the standard derived-category universes. Apply exists_baseDerivedTensor_restricted_ring_comparison with identity ring equivalences and canonical identity scalar-restriction isomorphisms. Its Aq-action clause and tensor induction promote the second-ring-linear comparison to Aq tensor_R Rprime-linearity. Its ordinary comparison clause and localized_eq, transposed through scalar-extension adjunction, yield the localizedComparison square. Then apply base and second-factor localization in the standard universe, as in the preceding step. All comparisons keep Q and its Aq-action fixed.

For an arbitrary tau with the stated numerator action, define sigma=beta inverse followed by tau. The numerator equation for beta and beta.hom_inv_id show that sigma sends 1 tensor the germ of x to 1 tensor that same germ. Compare sigma composed with beta with the canonical ordinary chain map composed with beta. Both agree on 1 tensor x in each term of D tensor_A M, so ExtendScalars.hom_ext identifies them. Cancel beta. Applying homology to this equality gives the comparison equation with H(beta inverse followed by tau). Zero modules and identity localizations obey the same equations; if Aprime is zero there is no prime p.

proof_origin.place: Affine displayed localization identity with the A-stalk held fixed; Tag 06Y6 for the common K-flat model.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_affineStalkBaseSecondLocalizationComparison
    (R A R' A' : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing R'] [CommRing A']
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R R'] [Algebra (A ⊗[R] R') A']
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wM} (ModuleCat.{u} R)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wM} (ModuleCat.{u} R')]
    (φg' : A →+* A') (φf' : R' →+* A')
    (hφg' : (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] R') A').comp
      (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] R')) = φg')
    (hφf' : (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] R') A').comp
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom = φf')
    (sq : IsPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φg')) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φf'))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A)))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R R'))))
    (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (i : ℤ)
    (p : PrimeSpectrum A') :
    let P := ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex _ _ _ _ _ _ _
      (@id (ModuleCat.{u} A ⥤
        SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))
          (tilde.functor (.of A))) ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (.up ℤ)).obj M)
      let f := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A))
      let f' := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φf')
      let g := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R R'))
      let g' := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φg')
      let D : Type u := (Spec.structureSheaf A').presheaf.stalk p
      let κ := (StructureSheaf.toStalk A' p).hom
      let Aq : Type u := (Spec.structureSheaf A).presheaf.stalk (g' p)
      let κA := (StructureSheaf.toStalk A (g' p)).hom
      let α := (g'.stalkMap p).hom
      letI : Algebra R Aq := (κA.comp (algebraMap R A)).toAlgebra
      (ψ : Aq ⊗[R] R' →+* D) →
      ψ.comp (algebraMap Aq (Aq ⊗[R] R')) = α →
      ψ.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom = κ.comp φf' →
      letI := ψ.toAlgebra
      let Q := SingleComplexBaseChange.stalkComplex g' p P
      (m : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R Aq R' Q D) →
      let C := ((ModuleCat.extendScalars (κ.comp φg')).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj M
      let φ₁ := ψ.comp (algebraMap Aq (Aq ⊗[R] R'))
      let C₁ := ((ModuleCat.extendScalars φ₁).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q
      (β : C ≅ C₁) →
      (∀ (j : ℤ) (x : M.X j),
        β.hom.f j ((1 : D) ⊗ₜ[A, κ.comp φg'] x) =
          (1 : D) ⊗ₜ[Aq, φ₁]
            (TopCat.Presheaf.germ (P.X j).val.presheaf ⊤ (g' p) trivial
              (tilde.toOpen (R := .of A) (M.X j) ⊤ x))) →
      letI := SingleComplexBaseChange.leftAlgebra f g' p
      letI := SingleComplexBaseChange.rightAlgebra f f' g g' sq p
      letI := (SingleComplexBaseChange.tensorMap f f' g g' sq p).toAlgebra
      letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} (SingleComplexBaseChange.R f g' p))
      letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} (SingleComplexBaseChange.B f' p))
      let ρ := (SingleComplexBaseChange.tensorMap f f' g g' sq p).comp
        (algebraMap (SingleComplexBaseChange.A g' p)
          (SingleComplexBaseChange.A g' p ⊗[SingleComplexBaseChange.R f g' p]
            SingleComplexBaseChange.B f' p))
      let l :=
        (SingleComplexBaseChange.cohomologyModel f f' g g' sq p P).localizedComparison i
      ∃ e : (ModuleCat.extendScalars ψ).obj (m.cohomology i) ≅ (Arrow.mk l).left,
        ∀ τ : C ≅ SingleComplexBaseChange.tensorComplex f f' g g' sq p P,
          (∀ (j : ℤ) (x : M.X j),
            τ.hom.f j ((1 : D) ⊗ₜ[A, κ.comp φg'] x) =
              (1 : (Spec (.of A')).presheaf.stalk p) ⊗ₜ[SingleComplexBaseChange.A g' p, ρ]
                (TopCat.Presheaf.germ (P.X j).val.presheaf ⊤ (g' p) trivial
                  (tilde.toOpen (R := .of A) (M.X j) ⊤ x))) →
          m.localizedComparison i ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
            (β.inv ≫ τ.hom) i = e.hom ≫ l
